messages:
alyssa: Quick heads-up — product wants to flip default routing to v2 for new orgs next week. Main worries: old clients that rely on v1 headers might get routed incorrectly and spike v2 quotas. Need routing/console/telemetry plan.
mark: +1 on risk. Do we have a reliable client signal today? many clients send `x-client-version`, some only include `Accept` or query param.
sanjay: We currently use header precedence: `x-client-version` -> `Accept` -> query param. But behavior is fuzzy for mobile SDKs that omit headers. That causes high entropy in routing.
alyssa: Can we add a deterministic fallback? e.g., prefer cookie-stored affinity, then header, then Accept, then param. Also show console hint when we force-routed a request.
ui-team: For the console UX: propose a subtle badge per-org: "Routing: v1 fallback active" with hover text showing reason (header missing / high entropy). Also an on-demand list of recent forced-routed requests (sampled).
mark: Telemetry needs: `route_entropy_1m`, `version_affinity_break_rate`, `forced_route_rate`, and `token_cost_delta_by_version`. Alert if forced_route_rate > 1% for an org for 10m.
sanjay: Implementation sketch for runtime routing rule (pseudocode):
```
route_policy:
  - match: cookie contains "rw_affinity_v"
    route: affinity_bucket
  - match: header "x-client-version" exists
    route: header_value
  - match: header "Accept" contains "application/vnd.redwood.v"
    route: accept_header
  - match: query param "version"
    route: query
  - else: route: default_v2_for_new_orgs
```
mark: That looks fine. Two additional concerns: 1) quota mapping — we need to map v1 quotas to v2 equivalents during grace period to avoid sudden throttling. 2) backward-compat headers (some clients expect legacy behavior).
ops: For quotas, suggest a transient mapping table: v1_quota -> v2_quota (1:1 for 14 days), and then ramp to 0.8 ratio over next 28 days. We'll emit an event `quota_mapped_v1_to_v2` for billing/analytics.
alyssa: Good. Also need console rollout UX: let admins opt-out org-by-org, and show a countdown grace period banner. Add a quick toggle "Prefer v2 for new traffic" with informative tooltip.
ui-team: We'll add the badge + a detailed modal showing the sampled forced routes and a button to open support. Also wire a ``Why was my traffic routed to v1?`` helplink.
mark: One more: let's add a sampling probe to do canary conversions: route 0.1% of v1-flagged clients to v2 under an experiment id, record latency/regression signals, and auto-fallback if quality delta > threshold. Emit `v1_to_v2_probe_{org}` metric.
sanjay: Agree. We should also tag logs with `route_reason` and `version_signal` to make debugging easier (e.g., `route_reason: missing_header`, `version_signal: accept_header`).
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/route-heuristics-config -> staging in 15m :rocket:
ops: Alerts/monitors to add: `forced_route_rate > 1%` (P3), `version_switch_spike` (P2), and `route_entropy > baseline * 2` (P1).
alyssa: Action items: 1) eng-platform: implement fallback order + tagging (sanjay) 2) ui: badge + modal + toggle (ui-team) 3) telemetry: add metrics & alerts (mark) 4) ops: quota mapping and deploy plan (ops) 5) product: prepare customer communications (alyssa)
mark: timeline: staging deploy today, canary on 5 orgs tomorrow, full opt-in by next Tue, default flip two weeks after canary if metrics ok.
alyssa: Thanks everyone — I'll draft the console copy and product note. If issues, ping @sanjay or @mark. :eyes:
